topics.name: Architecture & Deployment
topics.description: Platform Analytics solution components, deployment tasks and sequence, common use cases, personas and stakeholders.

introduction.overview: Platform Analytics (Performance Analytics) is ServiceNow's solution for visualizing trends, identifying bottlenecks, and measuring KPIs. This domain covers the core architecture—indicators, breakdowns, data collection, and dashboards—as well as deployment considerations like Premium vs Complimentary features.
introduction.whyItMatters: Architecture & Deployment is 10% of the CIS-PA exam. Questions focus on premium vs complimentary features, plugin activation, data collection components, and typical PA use cases.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the difference between Premium PA (custom indicators, unlimited history) and Complimentary PA (180-day limit, pre-built only). Know the Data Collector's role in taking snapshots, the relationship between Indicator Sources and process tables, and the Subscription Management auto-activation starting in Tokyo.
introduction.examTips: Remember that Complimentary PA limits you to 180 days of historic scores. Premium PA enables custom indicators, breakdowns, and widgets. Plugin activation happens via System Applications > All Available Applications.

topics.name: Indicators & Indicator Sources
topics.description: Source conditions, facts tables, indicator types, configuration properties, and aggregation scripts.

introduction.overview: Indicators are the heart of Performance Analytics—they define WHAT you measure. An Indicator points to an Indicator Source (the data) and specifies HOW to aggregate it (count, sum, average). This domain covers manual vs automated indicators, formula indicators, and advanced configuration.
introduction.whyItMatters: Indicators & Indicator Sources represent 25% of the CIS-PA exam—the largest domain. Expect questions on indicator types, source conditions, facts tables, aggregation methods, and scripted indicators.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master the indicator types: Manual (user-entered), Automated (GlideRecord queries), Formula (derived from other indicators). Know that Indicator Sources filter the source table (like a saved query), and Facts tables store snapshot data for time-series analysis.
introduction.examTips: Remember that Formula indicators calculate in real-time from collected scores—they don't collect their own data. Automated indicators require an Indicator Source. The 'direction' field indicates whether higher or lower scores are desirable.

topics.name: Breakdowns & Breakdown Sources
topics.description: Breakdown sources, mappings, breakdown matrix, exclusions, scripted breakdown mapping, and bucket groups.

introduction.overview: Breakdowns slice indicator data into dimensions—by assignment group, priority, category, or any other field. Breakdown Sources define the available values, and Breakdown Mappings connect breakdowns to Indicator Sources.
introduction.whyItMatters: Breakdowns & Breakdown Sources account for 25% of the CIS-PA exam. Questions cover breakdown source types, breakdown mappings, the breakdown matrix, scripted mappings, and bucket groups for custom ranges.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the three breakdown source types: Manual (static list), Automated (dynamic from table), and Bucket group (numeric ranges). Breakdown Mappings specify which field connects the indicator source to the breakdown. The Breakdown Matrix shows all indicator-breakdown combinations.
introduction.examTips: Breakdowns don't collect data themselves—they categorize indicator scores. A single indicator can have multiple breakdowns. Bucket groups are essential for numeric fields like 'time to close' where you want ranges (0-1 hour, 1-4 hours, etc.).

topics.name: Data Collection
topics.description: Data collection process flow, collection configuration properties, fine-tuning and troubleshooting.

introduction.overview: Data Collection is the engine that powers Performance Analytics. Scheduled jobs query process tables, calculate indicator values, and store results in Scores tables. This domain covers collection frequency, job configuration, and troubleshooting.
introduction.whyItMatters: Data Collection is 10% of the CIS-PA exam. Questions focus on the collection process, scheduled jobs, collection properties, and troubleshooting failed collections.
introduction.keyConcepts: The Data Collector runs on a schedule (daily by default), querying Indicator Sources and storing results in pa_scores. Collection jobs are separate for indicators and snapshots. Historical data can be collected for past periods.
introduction.examTips: Know that collection frequency affects storage and performance. Daily collection is default; more frequent collection increases storage. The pa_collector_trigger scheduled job initiates data collection.

topics.name: Visualization & Dashboards
topics.description: Platform Analytics visualizations, unified filters, choosing visualizations, dashboard management, performance, and KPI Details.

introduction.overview: Dashboards bring indicators to life through widgets, charts, and scorecards. This domain covers widget types, dashboard creation, unified filters, and the Analytics Hub for exploring KPI details.
introduction.whyItMatters: Visualization & Dashboards represent 25% of the CIS-PA exam. Expect questions on widget configuration, dashboard sharing, unified filters, and choosing the right visualization for different data types.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master the widget types: Scorecard (single value), Time series (trend over time), Column/Bar charts (comparisons), Pivot tables (breakdown matrix). Know how unified filters apply across dashboard widgets and how to configure widget drilldowns.
introduction.examTips: Scorecards are best for single KPIs with targets. Time series show trends. Column charts compare categories. Pivot tables show multi-dimensional breakdowns. Remember that unified filters reduce dashboard clutter.

topics.name: Administration & Advanced Solutions
topics.description: Content packs, platform features for advanced data collection, and Spotlight configuration.

introduction.overview: Advanced PA solutions include Content Packs (pre-built indicator sets), Spotlight (automated anomaly detection), and integration with other ServiceNow features like Predictive Intelligence and dashboards.
introduction.whyItMatters: Administration & Advanced Solutions is 5% of the CIS-PA exam—the smallest domain. Questions cover content pack installation, Spotlight configuration, and advanced integration scenarios.
introduction.keyConcepts: Content Packs are pre-built PA configurations for specific applications (ITSM, CSM). Spotlight uses machine learning to detect anomalies in indicator trends. Admin tasks include role management, content migration, and performance tuning.
introduction.examTips: Content packs include indicators, breakdowns, and dashboards—install them to quickly enable PA for standard applications. Spotlight requires Premium PA and sufficient historical data for anomaly detection.
